subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Does the reporter's v2026.6.11 Docker evidence establish a current secondary-agent heartbeat routing bug, or should maintainers first require a live reproduction that separates scheduled heartbeat from an untargeted `system event --mode now` wake?
rationale: Current source and tests show the intended per-agent path, while the reporter reports a real latest-release failure; automation cannot safely choose the next fix without live proof of which entry path is wrong.

options.title: Require live Docker reproduction
options.body: Ask for or run a redacted current-main Docker reproduction that proves whether scheduled historian2 heartbeat runs default-session code, then fix only that path.

options.title: Treat as manual-trigger confusion
options.body: If maintainers confirm only the untargeted system-event path is involved, update docs or CLI targeting instead of changing scheduled heartbeat routing.

options.title: Sponsor a broader routing audit
options.body: If the failure is intermittent across cron, system-event, and channel wakes, keep this as the canonical issue for a broader heartbeat routing investigation.

recommendation.title: Require live Docker reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a redacted current-main Docker reproduction that proves whether scheduled historian2 heartbeat runs default-session code, then fix only that path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged history on multi-agent heartbeat scheduling and prompt assembly, which is closest to the reported behavior.
